# 🛡️ Security Policy

## 🔒 Supported Versions

| Version | Supported | Next.js Baseline | Architecture Baseline | Security Maintenance Status |
| :--- | :---: | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **0.1.x (Current)** | :white_check_mark: | 16.3.x (App Router) | React 19 • Bun • Turbopack | **Active Security Support** |
| **< 0.1.0** | :x: | Legacy | Deprecated Monolith | End of Life (EOL) |

---

## 🚨 Reporting a Vulnerability

**GoVPN Security Team** mengutamakan privasi pengguna, integritas sesi multi-tenant, dan proteksi jaringan tunneling *Zero-Logs*. Jika Anda menemukan celah keamanan (*vulnerability*), mohon laporkan melalui saluran privat berikut:

1. **GitHub Private Vulnerability Reporting**: [Report a vulnerability](../../security/advisories/new)
2. **Email Tim Keamanan**: [`security@hidessh.com`](mailto:security@hidessh.com) (cc: [`support@hidessh.com`](mailto:support@hidessh.com))
3. **Telegram Emergency Incident Response**: [https://t.me/hidessh](https://t.me/hidessh)

> [!CAUTION]
> **JANGAN MEMBUAT ISSUE PUBLIK DI GITHUB UNTUK LAPORAN KERENTANAN KEAMANAN.**  
> Mohon berikan waktu bagi tim teknis kami untuk memverifikasi dan merilis patch perbaikan sebelum mempublikasikan informasi kerentanan.

---

## ⏱️ Response SLA

- **Konfirmasi Penerimaan**: < 24 Jam
- **Triase & CVSS Assessment**: < 48 Jam
- **Rilis Patch Mitigasi**: 1–3 Hari Kerja
